turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:

I work. Now I use "he". So I add -s. He works.
With he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: She sleeps at ten. Wrong: She sleep at ten.

Now it is your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)

turns.learner: Hello again! Can we practise he, she and it with -s again today?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Think about "I work". What changes with "she"?

Watch me: "I work." The person changes to "she". So I add -s: "She works."

The rule: after he, she or it, put -s on the verb.

Right: It works well. Wrong: It work well.

Try this: She ___ (walk) to school. Write only the verb.
